summary: Full end-to-end verification of the async generation fix (bug 502) and session persistence. Backend pytest: 12/12 passing including new async generate+polling test and refresh-token test. Frontend Playwright: full workflow login -> reload persistence -> Bloc1 CV upload -> Bloc2 job analyze -> Bloc3 async generation (POST returned pending in <1s, score-card visible after ~27s via polling, NO 502) -> Bloc4 ATS -> Bloc5 template + review + export PDF & DOCX (both downloaded). Fixed a small React render crash (defensive coercion) that appeared when the LLM occasionally returns matched/missing skills as objects {skill, source} instead of strings.

ui_bugs.component: Step3Generate MiniList (Correspondances / Manquants dans le CV)
ui_bugs.issue: React crash 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {skill, source})' when LLM returned matched/missing_hard_skills as objects instead of strings. FIXED via defensive asStr() coercion mapping x.skill|keyword|name to a string before rendering.

action_items: (Optional) Add server-side normalisation in llm_service.generate_match to force matched_/missing_*_skills to List[str] so the UI never receives objects — the current frontend fix is defensive but the schema should be enforced backend-side.
critical_code_review_comments: llm_service.generate_match: schema is only described in the prompt; Claude occasionally violates it (returns objects with {skill, source}). Add a post-processing step (Pydantic model or simple loop) to coerce to plain strings before writing to Mongo.

gen_router POST /generate spawns asyncio.create_task without any retry/timeout/observability. If the LLM call hangs, the session stays 'pending' forever with no watchdog. Consider a max duration + status='error' fallback.
polling every 2.5s from the browser is fine for a preview app, but consider Server-Sent Events or WebSocket for production to lower latency/bandwidth.

Access-token TTL raised to 8h and refresh_token stored in localStorage — pragmatic but weaker than httpOnly cookies. Given previous iteration already chose Bearer+localStorage for reload reliability, this is acceptable but worth flagging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full e2e passed after Step3 render fix)

test_credentials: admin@matchipy.com / Matchipy2026! (works). CV at /tmp/sample_cv.pdf used and parsed correctly (Camille Dupont).
seed_data_creation: None persistent; the pytest delete_cv step cleans up its own uploaded CV.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs are fixed and verified: (1) 502 on Bloc 3 -> POST /generate is now async (returns status=pending in <1s), polling GET /generate/{id} reaches ready in ~25-30s; measured elapsed 27s in the browser, no 502 seen. (2) Session persistence after reload works (verified again). A latent React crash in Step3 MiniList (LLM sometimes returns skill objects) was fixed with defensive rendering — main agent should still consider enforcing the schema server-side. backend_test.py now includes async generate polling and /auth/refresh via body test.
rca of the issue: Bug 502 RCA: the original POST /api/generate blocked the HTTP request while awaiting the Claude LLM (20-60s), longer than the edge/ingress timeout (~30s) -> 502. Fix (already applied in code before testing): insert a 'pending' session, launch _run_generation as asyncio.create_task, return immediately; frontend polls GET /generate/{id} every 2.5s until status becomes 'ready' or 'error'. Verified via curl AND browser: POST returns in ~0.1s, ready reached after ~27s, zero 502. Secondary Step3 crash RCA: LLM output schema drift — Claude sometimes returns matched_hard_skills as list of objects {skill, source} instead of list of strings. Rendering those directly inside <Badge>{x}</Badge> throws the classic React 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error, unmounts Step3 subtree, and blocks the user on the loader screen. Mitigation: added asStr() coercion in Step3Generate. Long-term: enforce schema in llm_service.generate_match.
